lab.title: Device lab
lab.description: Drive simulated field units over the real device protocol — heartbeats, leases, print events and signed commands — and inject faults to see how the platform reacts.

disclaimer.title: Simulator, not hardware
disclaimer.body: These units are software stand-ins seeded for the demo. Nothing here is printed on paper, and nothing here proves that a real printer, cutter or sensor works.

lab.loadError: The simulated units could not be loaded.

none.title: No simulated units
none.body: Run the demo seed (pnpm setup) to create simulated units.

knobs.title: Fault injection
knobs.hint: Red switches inject a fault. Changes apply on the next tick.
knobs.onlineHint: Every request fails; jobs wait in the queue.
knobs.cutterJamHint: Fails after printing → delivery needs review.
knobs.chuteSensorFailHint: Sensor never fires → uncertain, never reprinted.
knobs.rebootMidPrintHint: Power is cut after printing starts; reports interrupted.
knobs.dropAckOnceHint: First print-completed event is retried from the outbox.

printer.title: Printer output
printer.note: 1-bit raster exactly as received by the unit, shown at native resolution.
